context: Car rental. Net loss of $747M in FY2025. Analyzed at the corporate level: vehicle debt ($11.6B) is serviced by the fleet through a separate financing structure, so EBITDA is after vehicle depreciation and vehicle interest, and debt is non-vehicle only.

manual.cite: Balance sheet (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1657853/000165785326000008/R3.htm): Non-Vehicle Debt, Total debt 5,425.

totalDebt.note: Paired with corporate EBITDA. Vehicle debt is serviced by the fleet, and its cost is already in EBITDA.

manual.cite: Cash-flow statement supplemental (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1657853/000165785326000008/R13.htm): Interest, net of amounts capitalized, Non-vehicle, 463.
10-K Item 1: Hertz "is a successor to corporations that have been engaged in the vehicle rental and leasing business since 1918." 2025 - 1918.

pretaxIncome.note: Hertz Global (HGH) consolidated pre-tax loss, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1657853/000165785326000008/R7.htm. The Hertz Corporation subsidiary reports -786.

manual.cite: Statement of operations (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1657853/000165785326000008/R7.htm): Interest expense, net, Non-vehicle, 469.

creditRating.why: S&P Global Ratings site (read by Joel 2026-10-08): downgraded to CCC+ on 2026-08-12. The rating in effect at the 10-K filing (2026-02-26) is not yet confirmed. Every B or CCC rating maps to Weak (Joel's rule), so Weak holds unless Hertz was BB- or higher on 2026-02-26.

maintenanceCapex.estimate: Non-vehicle depreciation ($95M) used as maintenance capex proxy. Vehicle depreciation is already deducted in corporate EBITDA. Actual non-vehicle capex was $97M.

caveats: JUDGMENT, EBITDA definition: GAAP build used (pre-tax -830 + non-vehicle interest 469 + non-vehicle D&A 117 = -$244M). Company-reported Adjusted EBITDA in the segment note (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1657853/000165785326000008/R114.htm) is -$48M for the two segments combined and -$291M for Corporate. It adds back items management treats as one-off. All three readings are negative, so the direction of the verdict does not depend on the choice.
JUDGMENT, interest: statement of operations shows non-vehicle interest of $469M. The segment note shows "non-vehicle debt interest, net" of $498M. Different measures. $469M used.
SYNTHETIC STRUCTURE: Hertz does not fund its fleet with single-lender equipment finance. The deal terms are hypothetical and test the corporate credit read, not a realistic structure.

RATING TIMING: the S&P rating at the 10-K filing date (2026-02-26) is unconfirmed. The 2026-08-12 CCC+ downgrade post-dates the filing. Also unconfirmed: whether CCC+ is the issuer credit rating or a rating on specific notes. Weak is used either way, and would only change if Hertz was BB- or higher in February 2026.
